create.title: Complete fixed-even-order distinct-squarefree-class reduction by relative absorption
create.statement_tex: Fix the nonnegative real radial smooth unit-mass mollifier rho supported in the unit disk, Psi(s)=rho-hat(s e1), and nonnegative smooth w supported[1/2,2], equal1 on[1/sqrt(2),sqrt(3)]. For real T>=2 define a_n(T)=r2(n)n^(-3/4)Psi(sqrt(n/T)), f_d(R)=sum_(s>=1)a_(d s^2)(T)cos(2pi R s sqrt(d)-3pi/4) for squarefree d, B_T=sum_d f_d, L_Q=sum_(d<=Q)f_d, Z_Q=sum_(d>Q)f_d, V_Q=sum_(d>Q)f_d^2 for real Q>=1. Let p>=2 be any fixed even integer independent of T, E_(p,Q) the ordered pairwise-distinct d_1,...,d_p>Q product sum, I_(p,Q)=integral w E_(p,Q), M_p(F)=integral w|F|^p, and J_(p,Q)=integral w V_Q^(p/2). For every0<delta<1, integral w|Z_Q^p-E_(p,Q)|<=delta M_p(Z_Q)+C_(p,delta)J_(p,Q), where C=(p!-1)max(1,((p!-1)/delta)^((p-2)/2)). Thus (1-delta)M_p(Z_Q)<=I_(p,Q)+CJ, I_(p,Q)>=-CJ and |I_(p,Q)|<=(1+delta)M_p(Z_Q)+CJ. For every sufficiently small eta>0, J<<_(p,eta)T Q^(-p/4+eta), while M_p(L_Q)<<_p T Q^(p/4). All harmonics and infinite tails converge absolutely for each fixed T and are retained. At Q=1, the full B_T moment, Z_Q moment, |I_(p,Q)| bound and one-sided I_(p,Q) upper bound at T^(b+epsilon) are equivalent for every b>=1, with each bound quantified for every epsilon>0. At Q=floor(T^(1/p)), the same holds for b>=5/4, or b>=h_p=1+(p-136/13)_+/(4p) using the inherited coefficient-mask distribution; that optional head proof is restricted to1<=Q<=T. For a complete normalized moment exponent b>=1, sharp reconstruction and inclusive-count persistence give exponent1/4+(1+2b)/(4(p+1)). An unbounded sequence of fixed even orders with actual one-sided signed exponents b_p=o(p) would imply the quarter theorem, after paying the head floor. Those signed estimates are not proved. Constants may depend arbitrarily on fixed p; no p growing with T, no tuplewise absolute estimate, no stronger additive replacement of216, no improved full moment or pointwise exponent, and no M1/M2/GAR/endpoint or quarter proof is asserted.
create.next_action: Prove an actual signed distinct-class aggregate upper bound with a complete improved budget; a b_p=o(p) family at unbounded fixed even orders would suffice for quarter. Preserve signed cancellations and the accepted absolute-certificate obstruction. The reduction alone improves no complete exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Accept one reviewed all-fixed-even-order relative-absorption and complete actual distinct-class reduction. Repeated-class terms are absorbed without a baseline beta cost; Q=1 pays head and defect at O(T), and the growing cutoff has explicit paid budgets. The actual signed-integral estimates remain open. No complete moment, pointwise exponent or target parent is improved.
